data.body:
Plan reconciled against ACTUAL post-2948 code after 4th review-plan BLOCK (6 findings). Root cause of the round: v3/v4 edits described a stale per-criterion recovery + hand-placed CachePoint. Corrected against the code as it now stands:
- G1G2: assemble_context is SHARED (also _review_ticket_impl / review_workflows). Added opt-in 'prefetch: PrefetchSpec | None = None' (default None → those callers byte-unchanged); only gate_ops passes a spec. graph flag now only selects own vs subtree set WITHIN a spec.
- G6/prereq: NO hand-placed CachePoint. Prefetch rides the byte-stable fenced ticket_context, cache-read under the existing automatic message-tail arm; aligns with 2948's static-prefix-before-<!--volatile--> cache note.
- prereq: recovery is post-2948 BATCHED successor runs (ceil(remainder/batch_cap), ≤8/batch), NOT per-criterion. Prefetch reaches successors automatically because successor_instructions embeds the same assembled ticket_context; static prefix cache-hits across the few batches; physical_context_ceiling already bounds len(context), prefetch bytes included so oversize is trimmed.
- T8: trusted paragraph goes in completion_verifier.md BEFORE <!--volatile-->, so successor_system_prompt inherits it from a single source (co-located on both paths).
- COH/E6/F1: 4 live traces are all graph=False close-path; close-path coverage measured against them, graph=True subtree-union coverage measured against the named e369 112-path fixture instead.
